recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It removes a real conformance contradiction without broadening into the separate R6 dosage example/modeling backlog.
issue_request: FHIR-54014 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 Pharmacy dosage redesign. It requested requiring DosageDetails.renderedInstruction so implementers and end users always have a human-readable representation of dosage intent, with accepted definition/comment text requiring the full structured dosage information to be represented.
initial_application: Prior FHIR-54014 commits efe537aa9a928e9adbd54659c83cd02482cb34e9 and b641e8e249fac89aeac83d6e3f5e0e275ccb1058 updated the active DosageDetails spreadsheet source and selected medication examples. The datatype source is in build scope via active source/fhir.ini DosageDetails entries and already has renderedInstruction at 1..1 with the accepted definition/comment.
additional_context: The January 2026 Pharmacy WG minutes corroborate the Jira decision: the group chose SHALL, made .renderedInstruction mandatory, and voted 6-0-0. Later dosage work such as FHIR-54651 touched the same narrative for DosageDetails.simple removal but did not reverse the mandatory renderedInstruction decision. Related rendered-instruction tickets FHIR-54032 and FHIR-54793 are still Triaged and were not decided.
reconciliation: Edited source/dosage.html so the active narrative no longer says renderedInstruction may be present or only SHOULD be considered. It now states DosageDetails must contain renderedInstruction and that the required renderedInstruction communicates the full dosage intent.
source_changes: source/dosage.html: changed the dosage text narrative from optional/SHOULD renderedInstruction language to required/full-intent language consistent with DosageDetails.renderedInstruction 1..1.
